role: Four finite public ARIA reference helper boundaries

reviews.decision: The stable public addAriaReferencedId/removeAriaReferencedId declarations and primitive-string id-list semantics match the authentic16 reference at both exact minimum peers. Each current peer passes192 attribute/value/call comparisons and idempotence checks; no unrelated attribute or existing id is lost. The two complete historical modal ownership methods per component match untouched tagged bodies and execute with genuine public helpers over explicit Element attribute/closest protocols. Six original/minimum component-method replays check attachment, repeated attachment, moving between modals, preserving other ids, cleanup, repeat cleanup and removal of a final sole id. Eight nonempty runtime/source mutants fail and a local import alias passes. This closes the four finite imported helper boundaries; native DOM/screen-reader behavior, whole overlay/component lifecycle and runtime-floor qualification remain separate.
reviews.reviewer: Codex implementation-phase review; independent full audit pending
